answer: In this PoA design, identity verification requires continuous sequential modular squarings, where each state depends on the preceding one in a Wesolowski VDF. An attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize any individual dependency chain across GPUs, so extra hardware cannot remove its per-identity delay; clones merely incur additional work. This strict physical time bottleneck makes Sybil creation costly, while a pulse, cedar, or nectar label has no authority without a valid proof.
